name: StrictVersionedJson

parse.encoding: input bytes decode UTF-8 strictly before json parsing
reject: unknown contract version without explicit upgrader

contract_registry.unknown_field_policy: must be explicitly reject, preserve-readonly, or quarantine; silent discard followed by overwrite is forbidden

used_only_for: logical fingerprint/checksum where owning contract requires it
canonical_json.serialization: json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) encoded UTF-8 after contract-defined string normalization
canonical_json.ordinary_storage: property order has no business meaning and need not be canonical

upgrade.rule: validate old document with its exact historical contract, transform to one next accepted version, validate result, then commit atomically
upgrade.failure: prior stored document remains untouched; no default reset or partial overwrite

security: whole domain objects/ORM dumps are never accepted as fallback payloads
credentials, unrestricted Communication/Notes/provider bodies, raw exceptions and environment dumps are prohibited unless a narrower owning security contract explicitly allows one bounded field
sanitization cannot turn prohibited source material into permission to persist it
